reason: Both plans satisfy every hard requirement equally well—three clearly percentaged, sequenced phases with concrete entry/exit criteria, five correctly formatted RISK lines, an explicit separation of legacy decommissioning from the final migration phase, numeric halt thresholds, and a correct PHASES: 3 footer. Quality differences are minor and offsetting: A adds more operational detail per phase (cohort selection, activities lists) and an explicit post-migration decommission outline, while B offers a more rigorous multi-metric halt-condition section and cleaner batch-size math, leaving neither clearly more correct or useful than the other.
